title: Deterministic-auditor input spec (template)
description: Copy to skills/<your-skill>/schemas/<thing>.schema.json and replace the properties with the fields your scorer reads. Every field the scorer branches on must be a structured type (enum/boolean/number/array) — no free-prose fields the scorer would keyword-match.

clauses.description: Example structured field — replace with your own.

enforcementMechanism.description: How the daemon actually enforces this clause; 'none' means it degrades to hope.
